name: oGMemory Context Engine
description: oGMemory integration plugin for OpenClaw. Implements long-term memory with semantic search and knowledge extraction. Automatically starts AGFS + ContextEngine services on gateway startup.

mode.description: local = auto-start AGFS + ContextEngine on gateway startup; remote = connect to already-running services

agfsServerDir.description: Path to AGFS server Go source directory (local mode). Env: AGFS_SERVER_DIR

agfsDataDir.description: AGFS data directory (local mode). Env: AGFS_DATA_DIR

projectRoot.description: ContextEngine project root directory. Env: CONTEXTENGINE_PROJECT_ROOT

memoryApiBaseUrl.description: ContextEngine HTTP API base URL (remote mode). Env: OGMEM_API_URL

authApiKey.description: API Key for oGMemory multi-tenant authentication. Env: OG_AUTH_API_KEY

authAccountId.description: Account ID for multi-tenant authentication. Env: OG_AUTH_ACCOUNT_ID

startupTimeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for each service to become healthy (default: 60000)

traceTimeoutMs.description: Max ms for each trace event HTTP attempt (default: 3000)

commitTokenThreshold.description: Pending token threshold to trigger async session commit (default: 20000)

prefetchEnabled.description: Whether to call oG-Memory prefetch before compose.

prefetchTopK.description: Maximum prefetch hits to stage in the session topic buffer.

compactTakeoverEnabled.description: Whether oGMemory owns final compact result generation. Pre-compaction extraction still runs when disabled.

summaryMaxChars.description: Maximum compact summary length in characters.

shortTermIndexMode.description: Short-term index update strategy during compact takeover.

accountId.description: Default account ID for multi-tenant isolation

llmProvider.description: LLM provider: openai, mock. Env: CONTEXTENGINE_PROVIDER

llmBaseUrl.description: LLM API base URL (OpenAI-compatible). Env: OGMEM_BASE_URL

llmModel.description: LLM model name (default: gpt-4o-mini). Env: OGMEM_LLM_MODEL

embeddingProvider.description: Embedding provider. Defaults to llmProvider. Env: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

embeddingApiKey.description: Embedding API key. Defaults to llmApiKey. Env: OGMEM_EMBEDDING_API_KEY

embeddingBaseUrl.description: Embedding API base URL. Defaults to llmBaseUrl. Env: OGMEM_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model name (default: text-embedding-ada-002). Env: OGMEM_EMBEDDING_MODEL
